payload.text: With --safe-zone social at portrait, every mark and every line of type has its LAYOUT BOX inside the zone, and the bands that carry the content without a zone are empty of it; pictures still bleed to the frame's edge. Paint a theme puts outside an element's box -- a shadow, a stroke, a rotation -- is not what the zone insets and can still cross a band (issue 0055, measured at 293 px on one page of the popupart theme); hv ruled on 2026-09-22 that the wording narrows to what the zone controls rather than the zone moving for 2.12.0
